Results.ReviewText: We use our 22" kettle multiple times a week. It's easy to clean and is so versatile. I can get a flaming sear with Weber charcoal baskets while using minimal charcoal. I can also smoke briskets and pork shoulders low and slow using the snake method for 9 hours before needing to add more charcoal. We also bake pizzas too. The dome thermometer is accurate when compared to my remote digital thermometer. My next purchase will be a Weber 26" for times when we need to cook for a larger group.

Results.ReviewText: What can I say, the legends are true.  There maybe dozens of grills that look just like it (I've had many) but they are merely facades of the venerable Weber Kettle Grill.  This thing holds up the elements like no other.  I don't baby my tools, and this grill is no exception.  A big part of the value is in the ceramic coating.  Nothing gets through it so it holds up spectacular against regular use.  I'm a function over form, brand name, etc. kinda guy, and this brand (or at least product) has proven themselves.  Total worth the initial investment rather than cycling through bad products.

Results.ReviewText: I hadn't used a charcoal grill since I was in college 25 years ago.  I bought a propane Genesis after graduating, and it lasted 23 years (outside the whole time).  That is 23 Chicago winters.  Great product.  So when the cart finally disintegrated 2 years ago, of course I bought another one!  Last year I received a 22" Original Kettle Premium as a present.  Except for the copper color, it looked pretty much the same as the one I used in college.  Which looked the same as the one my father used when I was a kid.  I didn't think I'd use it much (since I have a new propane Genesis), so I took it to the cabin.  Getting the charcoal ready the first time seemed like a chore, but I finally got it lit.  Hint: get a chimney starter.  Once the meat hit the grate; the smoke, and the smells filled the air.  That is when the memories hit me.  Seeing my Dad tending the kettle at the neighborhood parties.  The smell of burgers, ribs, chicken, and steak being tickled with oak and hickory smoke.  At that moment I knew I was in trouble!  Soon after I got a second copper kettle to go next to my Genesis.  This led to a Smokey Mountain, Summit Charcoal Grilling Station, and I even pulled out my early 1970's Smokey Joe.   They ALL get used!   I think I need a "Q series for the cabin.  Sorry, I got a little off track on my review.  The Original Kettle Premium is everything you'd expect from a Weber grill.  The best outdoor cookers on the market.  The little extras like the ash catcher and the hinged grates are unbelievably handy.  Be warned though; just like Girl Scout cookies, it is hard to stop at just one.

Results.ReviewText:
I did a lot of research before choosing a grill and stopped on this one for multiple reasons (and still don't regret it).
- Very easy to control temperature with adjustable vents
- Ashpan and cleaning lever is an amazing feature/design! 
- Very convenient for 2 zone cooking
- Has many additional accessories (can be bought separately) 
- Great for low-n-slow cooking/smoking
- Great price for the quality and amount of features you get!

Couple of features/accessories that I would like to see in the next generation (if that will ever happen)
- Marking on lower vent to show when it is closed or half/fully open, so I don't have to open the lid to check- (My fix: drew little indicator marks with permanent marker)
- Add ceramic ring to sit on the lower grate to retain heat when it's 6F outside (My fix: Placed bricks around the circumference of a lower ring which makes it more efficient in the extremely cold weather, IMHO)
- Create an accessory stand/fixture for kabobs (My fix: place kabobs on a grilling grate, but it's not the same as caucasian kabob grilling)

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
